name: Emoto Yuzuna
source: The president of the second literature club. In reality, she is a magician who will curse anyone who gets in her way and is regarded as the scariest person in the school. While she constantly treats [url=/c44220]Yuuma[/url] like a slave, she still takes good care of him and looks after him. When Yuuma attempted to create a character based on her for his novel, his editor told him off for coming up with such a ridiculous idea.
